name: Mateo Fischer
headline: Software Engineer
summary: Software Engineer with a background in store operations and product-focused delivery. Experienced in building and supporting internal tools and backend services, with a practical approach to reliability, teamwork and continuous improvement. Comfortable working across cloud environments, deployment processes and access management.

Improved stock control routines and reduced checkout delays by 18% through better floor planning and clearer shift handovers.
Handled customer issues, returns and merchandising priorities while maintaining a smooth in-store experience.
Tracked sales performance and staffing needs to support weekly planning and stronger revenue outcomes.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built backend features in Python on Azure, helping ship new product flows for internal users and customers.
Standardized deployment work with Git and Helm, which cut release preparation time by 30%.
Supported incident response and routine maintenance across Azure services, improving uptime and reducing recurring faults.
Worked with product and support teams to refine integrations, diagnose defects and keep the platform stable at scale.

roles.title: Software Engineer
